    Our client, a leader in autonomous vehicle technology, is seeking a Readiness and Response Operator 2 (RR2) to join their team. As a Readiness and Response Operator 2, you will be part of the Fleet Operations team supporting Robotaxi Service Operations and Vehicle Readiness teams. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, exceptional customer service skills, and the ability to remain calm under pressure, which will align successfully in the organization.

    Job Title: Readiness and Response Operator 2 (RR2)
    Location: Los Angeles
    Pay Range: $32.00

    What's the Job?

    • Execute daily pre-service and post-service inspections to ensure Robotaxi fleet readiness, including vehicle, sensor, and systems verification.
    • Respond to field recovery events, coordinate vehicle extractions, document incidents, and support vehicle transportation activities.
    • Operate autonomous vehicles remotely when required for recovery, repositioning, or operational support.
    • Provide professional rider assistance during recovery events, ensuring passenger safety and delivering exceptional customer service.
    • Troubleshoot vehicle systems using internal software tools, perform firmware updates, and maintain vehicle cleanliness, charging, and operational readiness.

    What's Needed?

    • 2-4 years of experience in a fast-paced environment involving logistics, fleet operations, hospitality, aviation, emergency response, or customer service.
    • Strong technical aptitude with experience using laptops, mobile devices, software interfaces, and basic command-line or troubleshooting tools.
    • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record; ability to safely navigate high-traffic environments.
    • Proven ability to follow detailed procedures accurately while maintaining a strong customer-first mindset.
    • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical tasks including standing, walking, bending, pushing, and pulling throughout the workday.

    What's in it for me?

    • Opportunity to work at the forefront of autonomous vehicle technology and innovation.
    • Gain hands-on experience with advanced robotics and fleet operations systems.
    • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment.
    • Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding industry.
    • Meaningful role impacting the future of transportation and passenger mobility.
